newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee closes up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee closes up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.03 rupees up at 41.97 to the dollar on Thursday in the kerb market amid dollar profit-taking, dealers said.
They said the rupee might open higher after the Friday weekend as more players were selling dollars for rupees to invest in the bullish stock market.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.90 percent, from Wednesday's close at 5.0 percent.
